newPlayerRaids.$comment: The first `count` bot raids a village ever faces (after the new-player shield) bring a smaller, less researched army, so a new village with its first Kunai Tower usually holds (sim/defense.ts attackerFor).

defenseWin.$comment: A bot raid that wins no star pays the defender this share of its Keep's lowest generated raid loot, in Coins and Provisions (storage-capped).

rematch.$comment: Settle the score: once per bot raid, within `windowHours`, attack the raider's own generated base. No loot from buildings and no honor; a win (1+ stars) pays `shareOfRaidLoot` x stars/3 of the Keep's lowest raid loot.

exhaustion.$comment: Balance audit 2026-11-08 (exhausted stores): each raid the village lost (1+ star) in the last windowHours multiplies what the next raider can take by factor, offline and online.

diversity.$comment: Balance audit 2026-11-08 (diversity carries more): a won raid carries minShare + (1 - minShare) x min(1, D / fullAt) of its loot, D = 1 - sum of squared housing shares by role of the warriors that fought (the hero not counted).

stakes.$comment: Balance audit 2026-11-08 (declared stakes, opt-in): before a raid the attacker may declare 2 or 3 stars; reaching it carries the loot x byStars[stake], missing it carries nothing and a real defender keeps it. Without a declaration a raid carries its loot as before.
